areas close to the river and low-lying areas which is a small portion of the whole city only 358 families were reported to be affected but for davao we had minimal effects if this had happened elsewhere it could have been worse our lgu learned from the 2011 incident our 51 b flood control project protected millions of us 2 it is not a preparedness-issue unlike other cities our lgu has a world-class disaster and risk management plan our 911 is world-class our disaster and rescue facilities and equipment are world-class talk about our taxes-well spent talk about the years of good governance of the city government of davao living in davao we feel safe even in calamities knowing that our lgu will have early warning protocols search and rescue operations directives and the people
